claims.claim: RIOSE validates a versioned Simulation Request V1, invokes an explicitly selected external FREQUENCIA backend, and records a V1 result and provenance manifest.
limitations: analytic smoke does not bind request-specific fields

claims.claim: A small synthetic farm RF campaign executed through Sionna RT 2.2.0 on CPU with explicit synthetic terrain/shed geometry and returned LOS, NLOS, and NO_PATH classes across paired runs.
evidence: Run index and Sionna raw output
limitations: farm trees/fences/pasture are not all in the ray-traced mesh

claims.claim: FREQUENCIA analytic free-space plus flat-ground-reflection smoke is available as a separate backend and does not silently substitute for Sionna.
The 20-tag synthetic campaign exercised Sionna channel output through ns-3 3.48/LoRaWAN v0.3.7 and reported packet reception, gateway receptions, NO_PATH, and localization separately.
evidence: ns-3 network result and gateway event artifacts
limitations: PDR is unique transmitted packets received by at least one gateway at PHY
application/network-server delivery is unavailable and unclaimed
one channel/sub-band and one traffic interval

claims.claim: The synchronized synthetic control produced deterministic gateway interference events and zero packet reception while keeping NO_PATH and NOT_TRANSMITTED distinct.
External FREQUENCIA TDoA can converge while quality rejects an estimate outside request-declared operational bounds; ground truth is used only for post-estimation scoring.
evidence: seed 20261011 result with two converged estimates and 1319.494 m conditional RMSE, both rejected
limitations: quality acceptance does not establish accuracy

claims.claim: Removing one gateway preserves the remaining PHY reception results and yields no eligible TDoA estimate in the executed scenario.
limitations: multi-gateway simultaneous outage and recovery were not run

claims.claim: With identical input and seed, normalized Sionna RF outputs and the network, timestamps, localization, and scoring outputs are compatible and match in the recorded CPU environment.
limitations: Per-run ExperimentSpec hash and solver execution durations vary
three additional seeds are a small screening set

claims.claim: No physical, laboratory, or field validation claim is established by this mission.
evidence: No physical hardware or field measurements were used
limitations: All reported RF/network/localization metrics remain SIMULATED
